title: Constant-rank exterior complex as a shifted single exterior sheaf
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $M,N$ be sheaves of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and let $e:M\cong N$ be a module-sheaf isomorphism. Fix $d\in\mathbf N$ and the constant locally constant function $r(x)=d$. Let $L(M,r)$ be the locally ranked exterior complex [def-sc-locally-ranked-exterior-complex], and choose the derived category of module sheaves on X [def-pc-derived-category], with localization functor Q. Then $Q(L(M,r))\cong (\bigwedge^d N)[-d]$, where the exterior sheaf is the sheafification of sectionwise exterior powers [def-sc-sheaf-exterior-power] and the right side is its degree-zero single shifted by $-d$. No local freeness of M or N is assumed.

proof.text: In degree d, the rank-d open is the full open. Unfold the nonnegative term and use exteriorSheaf_fullOpen_pushforward_iso to identify it with exteriorSheaf M d. For nonnegative i different from d, i.toNat differs from d and the rank stratum is empty. Every open of this empty scheme is bottom, whose structure ring is subsingleton. Module.subsingleton makes every section module zero. Hence the pushforward identity is zero on each open, so the pushforward is a zero object. Negative terms are zero by definition. This is the objectwise classification proved by termIso.

Apply ModuleCat.exteriorPower.functor on each open U to the component isomorphism of e. For naturality, apply exteriorPower.linearMap_ext and check a pure wedge. The characterization in exteriorSheafRestriction_existsUnique expresses restrictions as restrictions of tuples; exteriorPower.map_apply_ιMulti maps the wedge through e, and PresheafOfModules.naturality_apply e.hom.val identifies the two tuples. PresheafOfModules.isoMk gives a presheaf isomorphism. Mapping it through sheafification gives exteriorSheaf M d isomorphic to exteriorSheaf N d. This is the proved helper exteriorIso.

Combine the term classification with HomologicalComplex.singleObjXIsoOfEq in degree d and isZero_single_obj_X elsewhere. HomologicalComplex.Hom.isoOfComponents assembles an isomorphism with the degree-d single complex: the equations reduce to zero differentials. Map by Q, invert the component of DerivedCategory.singleFunctorIsoCompQ, and map exteriorIso through the degree-d single functor. Finally invert the component of (DerivedCategory.singleFunctors C).shiftIso (-d) d 0, using -d+d=0. This composite proves the unchanged original statement.

A constant rank exterior sheaf complex is isomorphic in the derived category to its top exterior power shifted by the negative rank
